projects.title: Ecommerce
projects.description: This E-commerce Full Stack application is built with Next.js, MongoDB, React Hooks, and Bootstrap 4. It features functionalities like product management (add, delete, edit, categories), a shopping cart, PayPal payment integration, and user profile management (including password reset and avatar update). Admin privileges include managing orders, users, and categories. The site supports filtering, pagination, sorting, and searching products. Additionally, multiple images can be uploaded to Cloudinary. The application is deployed on Vercel for easy access and scalability.

projects.title: Quiz
projects.description: This Quiz Microservices project, is a backend system that dynamically generates quizzes and questions. It follows a microservices architecture, separating concerns into a Question Service and a Quiz Service, which communicate via Feign Client. The project also integrates Eureka Server for service discovery, API Gateway for centralized routing, and Load Balancing for efficient request handling. ✅Since there is no frontend, all interactions and testing are done using Postman to manage quiz creation and retrieval efficiently.
